notes.title: Patch Notes 2
notes.notes:
The track now curves and bends.
 Added a second art theme to all 7 stages.
 Added 3 new obstacle types.
 Added an Easter egg to the title screen.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the keybindings from saving.
    Fixed a bug that prevented Mashocist Tier 4 achievement from unlocking.
    Removed the charge core icon in the gameover ui displaying the number of charge cores collected because it was causing confusion about score totals.
    Changed the wording of achievement definitions to imply there is an ending to the game.
